license.scope: Root MIT text and plugin licence declaration inspected; no nested licence file overrides the selected plugin. Grant covers skill source, not a free subscription or third-party data resale rights.
obligations: Retain the original copyright and MIT permission/disclaimer notice.

assignments.essential_function: Run evidence-backed SEO audits and create the original saved HTML report.
native_prerequisites: Native OpenSEO MCP tools, account, credits and report storage; preserve the original plugin layout.
limitations: Current AutoGPT integration has not been tested. seo-report is a required companion with only 368 standalone installs, not an independently high-adoption recommendation.
Upstream Snyk scan flags medium indirect prompt-injection exposure through third-party crawl content. Source remains unchanged.

review: Prioritizes one to three SEO actions from live ranking checks, crawls, page-family review and an explicit opportunity shortlist. Strong native distinctions between missing data and absence, observation and cause, search volume and visits. Conditional on author-required OpenSEO MCP plus seo-report; not a generic text-only skill.
native_prerequisites: Original OpenSEO MCP endpoint/account and service credits; native tool names and project/report persistence must be supported.
original_native_prerequisites: Original OpenSEO MCP endpoint/account and service credits; native tool names and project/report persistence must be supported.
Install seo-audit with unchanged seo-report and preserve complete original plugin layout; service/API terms are separate from the MIT source grant.

dependency_decisions: Do not rename service skill: "seo-audit", docs URLs, source identity links or report attribution when changing marketplace display/registration names.
runtime_blockers: A package cannot provide OpenSEO authentication, credits, live SEO data or save_report/project persistence. Preserve the authored stop on missing connection.
